text: chest: Trachea and both main bronchi are open. Consolidation areas with air bronchograms are observed in the lower lobes of both lungs, more prominent on the right, consistent with pneumonia. Ground-glass densities are seen around the consolidations. Minimal pleural effusion on the right. Heart size is normal. No pericardial effusion. No lymph nodes in pathological size and appearance in the mediastinum.
